generated.temple-portrait.webp: Portrait adaptation generated from supplied empty background with image generation, 2026-11-16.

generated.bellkeeper.webp: Extracted individual transparent cell from same atlas.

sound: Original local Web Audio synthesis: rain, steel, scabbard, bell. No API, no recordings, no third-party music.
layers: Independent background, actors, procedural paint, telegraphs, weather, sound, and HTML HUD. Sprite paths live in art.js ASSETS.
share.jpg: Rendered title composition using supplied empty temple, generated ronin and original typography. No invented gameplay score.
